prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: wrist fracture. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1182; do not mention it.)
text:
I write to present a claim on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], arising from a collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was traveling in the right lane when the vehicle insured by your company moved into the same lane without signaling or confirming that the way was clear. The resulting sideswipe forced our client's vehicle against the guardrail and caused a significant impact to the driver's side.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a fracture of the wrist. Treatment has included emergency evaluation, immobilization, and a follow-up course of care with a specialist, and our client continues to experience pain, reduced grip strength, and restricted movement. Our client has also missed time from work and has been unable to perform routine daily tasks during recovery.

The police report documents the lane change as the cause of the incident, and the physical damage to our client's vehicle is consistent with the account described. Liability rests squarely with your insured.

Our client is prepared to resolve this matter without litigation. We demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] within thirty days of the date of this letter. Should we not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
